description: Search for a treasure using BST ordering rules.
hints: Compare the target key with the current room's key.
Move left if the target is smaller and right if it is larger.

description: Insert a treasure in its correct BST position.
hints: Start at the root and compare the new key with each visited node.
Insert the new node at the first available leaf position.

description: Delete a node based on its number of children.
hints: A leaf node can be removed directly.
A node with one child can be replaced by its child.
For two children, find the inorder successor in the right subtree.

mission: Collect treasures within a given range
description: Find treasure values within a specified range [lo, hi].
hints: Only visit nodes whose values could fall within the specified range.
Skip the left subtree when the current key is smaller than the lower bound.
Skip the right subtree when the current key is greater than the upper bound.

mission: Find the treasure before the guards arrive
description: Search a degenerated BST before the alarm runs out.
hints: Inserting sorted keys creates a right-leaning chain.
A degenerated BST can have a height equal to its number of nodes.
Every comparison consumes one alarm step.
